    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: A group named by the list's title; the templates are a listbox with options and aria-selected, only the chosen one is in the tab order
      - listitem: Every variable is a real text field labelled with its name and description
      - listitem: Use stays focusable while not ready (aria-disabled) and the last row says how many variables are missing
      - listitem: A polite live region announces when all variables are filled, when the prompt was copied and when it was used
      - listitem: The outgoing template that fades out during a switch is inert and hidden from screen readers
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The highlight slides along the list to the chosen template while the content crossfades – the old one fades out underneath
      - listitem: The part you type into lights up in the field and in the preview, then fades back
      - listitem: The token estimate in the last row rolls to its new value as you type
      - listitem: Use pulses once when the last variable gets filled; Copy turns into a check for a moment
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches without movement
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Fills its container up to 640px. Below 540px the list moves on top of the template; below 360px Copy keeps only its icon
      - listitem: Fields grow with what you type and never get wider than the line
      - listitem: "Touch screens: taller list rows, fields and buttons"
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: "Variables are written as {name} with letters, digits, - or _; the same name used twice is one field"
      - listitem: Values are kept per template inside the card, so switching back and forth keeps what was typed
      - listitem: The token number is an estimate (about four characters per token) – pass the prompt to your tokenizer when it has to be exact
      - listitem: Category colors follow the order the categories appear; set tone on a template to pick one
